title: Approximate median

problem.name: Approximate median
problem.statement_latex: Given indexed access to $n$ totally ordered values and $0<\varepsilon<1/2$, output an element whose rank lies between $(1/2-\varepsilon)n$ and $(1/2+\varepsilon)n$. The resource is bounded-error input queries.
problem.statement_text: Given indexed access to $n$ totally ordered values and $0<\varepsilon<1/2$, output an element whose rank lies between $(1/2-\varepsilon)n$ and $(1/2+\varepsilon)n$. The resource is bounded-error input queries.

strength.description_latex: Polynomial improvement in the stated resource and parameter regime.
strength.description_text: Polynomial improvement in the stated resource and parameter regime.

evidence.description_latex: The cited results establish a classical lower bound separating the stated quantum resource bound in the specified model.

quantum.headline_latex: $O(\min\{n,\varepsilon^{-1}\log(1/\varepsilon)\log\log(1/\varepsilon)\})$ queries by the Nayak--Wu approximate-selection algorithm.
quantum.headline_text: $O(\min\{n,\varepsilon^{-1}\log(1/\varepsilon)\log\log(1/\varepsilon)\})$ queries by the Nayak–Wu approximate-selection algorithm.

classical.headline_latex: $\Theta(\min\{n,\varepsilon^{-2}\})$ queries at constant confidence by random sampling and classical selection.
classical.headline_text: $\Theta(\min\{n,\varepsilon^{-2}\})$ queries at constant confidence by random sampling and classical selection.
